title: Jesus... I'm The Strong One. Nobody Ever Asks Me. 🪨
topic: she is the person everyone brings their problems to, and she has nowhere to put her own

bible.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm the strong one. Nobody ever asks me. 🪨

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I carried three friends' crises this week, drove one to the airport at midnight. Mine stayed in my notes app.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bring them here. I never asked you to be the strong one. That title was never Mine to give.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I break, who holds everyone else together?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Not your job. Let Me hold you, and you will hold them better after.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Your wilderness gets a way through. Set the strong mask down tonight.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the strong friend. 🪨
